findings.title: emit accepts findings with no evidence or citation requirement
evidence: tools/full_domain.py:303-338 validates only severity/title/status, never evidence
AGENTS.md:9 requires evidence or Unknown; prompts/00_SHARED_AUDIT_RULES.md mandates citations
aggregate renders the domain report from the payload verbatim (tools/full_domain.py:376-395)
findings.impact: A subagent (or a bug) can inject unsubstantiated findings into a run that passes check_run.sh.
findings.recommendation: Require a non-empty evidence list (or an explicit Unknown marker) in emit for P0/P1 at minimum.

findings.title: run --agent-cmd executes a shell template with unvalidated substitutions
evidence: tools/full_domain.py:670-675 builds a shell command from repo/run/branch/sha via .format and subprocess.run(shell=True)
findings.impact: A crafted repo/run name could inject shell commands into the driver host.
findings.recommendation: Pass arguments as an argv list instead of a formatted shell string.

report: Reviewed the full_domain driver's subagent contract and the agent-facing rules.
